sources.title: Welcome to Creators API — official documentation
sources.observed: Operations: SearchItems, GetItems, GetVariations, GetBrowseNodes. Prerequisites: enrolled in Associates for target marketplace; at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API; register through Associates Central; generate API credentials. SDKs: Node.js, Python, PHP, Java.
sources.used_for: Methodology: the only sanctioned product-data intake; gating threshold

sources.title: PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice
sources.observed: Serves a notice: "The Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (PA-API 5) has been deprecated and is being replaced by the Creators API." Callers still using PA-API 5 receive HTTP 403 Forbidden with __type com.amazon.paapi5#AccessDeniedException and Message "Product Advertising API is deprecated. Please migrate to Creators API...".
sources.used_for: Methodology: API architecture constraint; Flag FLG-014

sources.title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
sources.observed: Material-connection disclosure duty; "if a disclosure is needed in one post for a brand, it's probably needed in all posts, because you can't assume that viewers will see multiple posts"; "Each new endorsement made without a disclosure could be deceptive"; where audience awareness is hard to determine, "we recommend disclosure"; foreign publishers whose content is reasonably foreseeable to reach U.S. consumers are covered.
sources.used_for: Compliance: disclosure placement/frequency beyond Amazon's own rule

sources.title: Host resolution check for the submitted link domain
sources.observed: link.amazon -> 18.172.170.20/.59/.77/.98 (AWS range, consistent with Amazon infrastructure). amzn.to -> 67.199.248.12/.13 (third-party URL-shortener range, not an Amazon address block). Record: link.amazon is a live Amazon-served host; the failure is in the identifier, not the domain.
